video_title: I hit a GAME WINNER on the Lakers

quotes.speaker: Josh Giddey
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers' slow-paced, half-court offensive strategy against the Bulls
quotes.excerpt: The Lakers are usually a slow-paced team. They like to control the ball in the half-court.
quotes.quote: The Lakers are usually a slow-paced team. They like to control the ball in the half-court, control the pace of the game. Pat is our best defender, you trust him one-on-one, but Luka is a tough guy to guard one-on-one, so you have to show help.

quotes.speaker: Josh Giddey
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers' late-game strategy of hunting specific defensive matchups
quotes.excerpt: A lot of teams do this late game, they will start to match-up hunt.
quotes.quote: A lot of teams do this late game, they will start to match-up hunt. What Luka is doing now is bringing up his five-man to get a pick-and-roll. They knew we were switching things, so Vucevic is going to switch onto Luka, and they get the matchup they want.

quotes.speaker: Josh Giddey
quotes.summary_phrase: Defensive 'fill spots' strategy to prevent isolation scoring
quotes.excerpt: I am at the top of the key and we call fill spots.
quotes.quote: I am at the top of the key and we call fill spots. I am showing presentation, showing that I am there and there is no room for him to drive. Kobe could be up the line a little more, but he is in a good spot and we just want to show these guys that they are not playing in space. We have Vucevic's back, we are behind him, he has help there so we can get up and pressure the ball.

quotes.speaker: Josh Giddey
quotes.summary_phrase: Pat Williams' defensive awareness and smart switching
quotes.excerpt: Pat bumps me out to the corner, puts me onto Reeves, and he takes the five.
quotes.quote: You watch Pat on the backside, I am guarding Hayes, a five-man, and usually it is size on size, so Pat bumps me out to the corner, puts me onto Reeves, and he takes the five, which is a very smart play by Pat.

quotes.speaker: Josh Giddey
quotes.summary_phrase: Pat Williams' defensive discipline against Luka Doncic
quotes.excerpt: Pat, awesome job, deters Luka from driving and he is just sitting in that lane.
quotes.quote: Pat, awesome job, deters Luka from driving and he is just sitting in that lane. It is easier said than done because he has responsibility of Reeves as well if Luka kicks that out, but he does a great job sitting in the lane, making Luka pick the ball up and we force him into a tough step-back.

quotes.speaker: Josh Giddey
quotes.summary_phrase: Defensive challenges of guarding Luka Doncic in space
quotes.excerpt: Pat is guarding Luka, obviously a very talented offensive player.
quotes.quote: Pat is guarding Luka, obviously a very talented offensive player. You want to get the ball out of his hands, but if you think about where he is on the court, he is probably not a threat from that far. He can make a deep three, but in this point of the game, the ball is what scores and Pat probably should be in a bit of a fill at the top of the key.

quotes.speaker: Josh Giddey
quotes.summary_phrase: Risky defensive pass by LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: Risky pass because LeBron, you see the ball in the air right now, he could almost jump.
quotes.quote: Risky pass because LeBron, you see the ball in the air right now, he could almost jump this passing lane. He is going down the other end for a dunk and the game is probably over, but luckily he kind of hesitates, Vucevic gets the catch, Pat is wide open, so heads-up play by Vucevic to get it there quickly.

quotes.speaker: Josh Giddey
quotes.summary_phrase: Defensive wall formation by Lakers in final seconds
quotes.excerpt: I see Vucevic, Vincent, Kobe, LeBron, Luka is back, they are all kind of building the wall.
quotes.quote: I see Vucevic, Vincent, Kobe, LeBron, Luka is back, they are all kind of building the wall at half-court, so there is nowhere really for me to go. There is no one to pass to, one second left, I am not going to pass the ball back to Pat for a tougher shot.
